english.note: Use this when calling someone's behaviour cruel or inhumane, especially when it causes obvious suffering.

examples.english: It was callous of him to drive the patient out of the hospital just to save money.
examples.traditional: 為咗慳錢，佢竟然將病人趕出醫院，真係冇人性。
